# Milestone Plan: <Game Name>

> The path from nothing to shipped, in checkable milestones. Each one is playable.

## M0 — Prototype
The core loop, ugly but playable. Proves the game is fun. Throwaway-ok code.
- Exit criteria:

## M1 — Vertical Slice
One area / level fully built to shipping quality: real systems, real feel, real content. The template for everything else.
- Exit criteria:

## M2 — Content Complete
All systems built; all content authored from the content plan. Not yet balanced or polished.
- Exit criteria:

## M3 — Balanced & Polished
Tuning pass (registry + `/consistency-check`), game feel (`/add-game-feel`), performance (`/optimize-performance`), bug fixing.
- Exit criteria:

## M4 — Release
Build, store assets, final QA pass, ship.
- Exit criteria:

## Risks
Top risks per milestone and the mitigation. What could slip and why.
